in_sanskrit.name: शेखर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shekher is derived from the Sanskrit word 'शेखर' (shikhara), which means 'mountain'. It is a common name in India and is often used as a surname or as a part of a compound name.

in_hindi.name: शेखर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shekher in Hindi is the same as its Sanskrit origin, which is 'शेखर' (shikhara) meaning 'mountain'.

in_tamil.name: சேகர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Shekher is 'சேகர்' (cēkar), which translates to 'mountain' or 'summit'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'शेखर' (shikhara) and has a similar meaning.

in_telugu.name: శేఖర
